title: Diglycerides (E471): what we hold
standfirst: The published sources behind what we say, and what counting them cannot tell you.
intro: E471 (mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids) are emulsifiers made from glycerol and fatty acids, which may be plant- or animal-derived. They blend fat and water and improve texture in baked goods, spreads and more.
sections: Why it is in your food
